newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani money market rates swing, seen firm.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani money market rates swing, seen firm.

text.p: Pakistan's interbank rates fluctuated widely on Monday and dealers said they were likely to remain firm on Tuesday.
Bids and offers opened in the range of six and 10 percent respectively, a dealer at Standard and Chartered Bank said.
Some deals were closed at nine and 10 percent before rates moved up to 13 percent as a major lender held back funds, he said.
"The market is expected to remain at the same levels on Tuesday," he said.
